articles.summary: U.S. Department of Commerce, Consulate General of Japan in Houston, and industry partners join TOYO in Humble, Texas; Company shares plans for HJT cell line On October 6, TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO) ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturer, held a ribbon-cutting ceremony at its solar module manufacturing facility in Humble, Texas, marking the completed expansion of the facility's module nameplate capacity to 2 GW. The ceremony brought together government, community, and industry leaders, including Jeffrey I. Kessler, Under Secretary of Commerce for Industry and Security; Takeshi Koyama, Consul General of Japan in Houston; Congressman Christian D. Menefee; and Paul Wormser, Senior Vice President of CEA Intertek. Customers, partners, analysts, and investors also attended. The program included remarks, the ribbon-cutting, and tours of the factory floor. Earlier in the day on October 6, TOYO hosted an Analyst Day, where management presented the Company's strategy and growth plans.
articles.title: TOYO Celebrates Completed 2 GW Module Expansion at Texas Facility with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony
